_description: Weights for station investment opportunity scoring. Each factor is normalized to 0-100 before weighting. Weights must sum to 1.0.

factor_descriptions.demand_score: Historical average daily trip demand at this station
factor_descriptions.capacity_pressure_score: Ratio of daily demand to dock capacity (higher = more constrained)
factor_descriptions.mta_connection_score: Nearby MTA subway ridership and delay rate (transit opportunity)
factor_descriptions.coverage_gap_score: Inverse of nearby station density (higher = fewer alternatives)
factor_descriptions.revenue_potential_score: Estimated revenue contribution based on rider mix and trip volume
factor_descriptions.electric_bike_score: Share of trips using e-bikes (indicates willingness to pay premium)
